text:
Lina: Quick sprint  we need a tight battlecard + webinar hero for next week's launch. Goal: 2 headline tests, 3 benchmark callouts (legal-friendly), and a one-page SDR crib.
Ravi: Got it. Audience buckets: Devs (technical), Platform (SRE/product), Procurement (econ/SLA). Tone varies per segment.
Mae: Bench callouts (conservative): p95 latency under typical chat (256 tokens), relative per-token cost under mixed load (range), and failover recovery time with fallback models. Use footnote language.
Lina: Headlines to A/B: A) "Serve smarter, not louder." B) "Inference you can budget and trust." Need 6-word ad variants too.
SalesOps: Routing rules (human readable):
```
if utm_campaign == "webinar_launch" and lead_score >= 82:
  assign -> AE_queue
elif utm_campaign == "webinar_launch":
  assign -> SDR_queue
if region == "EMEA" and lead_score >= 82:
  assign -> EMEA_AE
```
Mae: Competitor soundbites (<=18 words + supporting line):
- Cloud AI platforms: "Wide services; inference economics fluctuate under real traffic mixes."
  Support: "Customers see variable p95 costs depending on workload mix."
- LLM APIs: "Easy start; limited production rollout and cache primitives."
  Support: "Few offer native KV-cache or pin/canary controls."
- Infra vendors: "You buy hardware; you still must build a serving runtime."
  Support: "Teams spend cycles reimplementing batching, cache, and quantization."
Lina: SDR crib asks: 3 elevator lines, 2 rebut bullets, and a 72-hour follow-up cadence (3 emails + 1 SDR touch).
SalesOps: For rebuts: "We already run on cloud X" -> "We complement cloud infra and reduce runtime spend via smart routing and caching."; "Ops is heavy" -> "Managed defaults and fallbacks minimize ops lift; no need to rebuild runtime plumbing."
Design-bot: I'll produce hero slide + social tiles once copy locks. Figma link will be posted.
Legal: Approve conservative wording if we add footnote: "Based on internal benchmarks across representative production mixes; results vary by configuration."
Lina: Timeline: drafts in this thread by EOD. Review meeting tomorrow 10am. Tag @Lina when done. :rocket:
